annotations.title: Get alerted when a service breaks

description: Use for services your agent pays or depends on repeatedly, so you learn about problems before the next payment. Needs a paid plan token (Pro: 20 watches, Team: 200; see list_plans). Pass url or id and webhook_url (https). Creates or updates a watch. When the service goes down, recovers, or changes its payTo, network or MCP tools, alalanet POSTs the signed, logged attestation to webhook_url; verify it with get_attestation. Free callers get an error that names the plans. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

id.description: service id from find_service results; give either id or url

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint or MCP server to watch (public https only: private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

webhook_url.description: public https URL that receives alalanet's signed alerts (the payload is always alalanet's attestation, never your data; private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused)

name: watch_service
title: Get alerted when a service breaks
